field.label: Listen Address
field.help: Addresses and ports to serve DNS on. A bare port listens on all addresses. The default of 5300 avoids a collision with Unbound; to serve the network on port 53, disable Unbound first.

field.label: IP Version
field.help: Which IP version to use when connecting to upstream resolvers.

field.label: Bootstrap DNS
field.help: Resolvers used to look up the hostnames of the upstream resolvers themselves. Leave empty to use the resolvers configured on this firewall.

field.label: Obfuscate Log
field.help: Obfuscate domain names and IP addresses in the log.

field.label: Collect Statistics
field.help: Collect in-memory query statistics. Required by the status page and the dashboard widgets.

field.label: Prometheus Metrics
field.help: Expose Prometheus metrics for scraping by an external monitoring system.

field.label: API Port
field.help: Port for blocky's HTTP API on the loopback address. The API is unauthenticated, so it is never bound to a routable address.
